usedFor: Cliengo captures chatbot leads, and Google Sheets stores each one as a row through “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer/Contact” in Cliengo, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new chatbot contact becomes a spreadsheet row your team can sort and share.

watchOut: “New Customer/Contact” is polling, so rows show up after a scheduled check, not the moment someone chats.
